title: Multi-channel announcement runbook and stakeholder synchronization for March release
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket coordinates the cross-team announcement plan for the March platform release. Goal: deliver a synchronized, multi-channel announcement (blog post, customer email, social posts, and a technical webinar) with accompanying release notes and support playbook. Runbook covers timing, approvals, asset owners, embargo controls, and fallback messaging for any last-minute regressions. The launch must align with Dedicated capacity updates and Console UI changes tracked in release artifacts.
tasks: Finalize release notes and changelog (owner: Product)
Create blog draft and hero visuals (owner: Marketing/Design)
Prepare customer email segments and templates (owner: Marketing)
Schedule and script webinar; collect demo checklist (owner: DevRel)
Social copy + cadence for Twitter, LinkedIn, and Mastodon (owner: Marketing)
Support playbook: FAQs, rollback guidance, escalation contacts (owner: Support)
Update docs site and API reference links (owner: Docs)
Add 'What's New' entry and SDK changelogs (owner: Eng Docs)
Create GitHub release and link to changelog (owner: Engineering)
Run embargo checklist and confirm asset propagation (owner: Product)
assets: Webinar slide deck and demo recording checklist
Release notes MD and changelog diff
